# iaas_microvm_runner_pool (Resource)

Manages a CI Runners pool (GitHub or GitLab). A GitHub pool must first be linked via the panel's Install GitHub App flow and then imported by id - `provider_type = "github"` does not support Create. A GitLab pool is fully managed here. Import (`terraform import iaas_microvm_runner_pool.<name> <pool-id>`) is the only way to manage a GitHub pool; gitlab_token is write-only and never returned by the API, so an imported GitLab pool keeps a null gitlab_token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitLab runner pools are fully managed here: create, update, delete. The
# gitlab_token is WRITE-ONLY: it is verified against GitLab on create and
# never returned by the API afterwards, so it is preserved in state (and can
# never be recovered for a pool created outside Terraform).
resource "iaas_microvm_runner_pool" "gitlab" {
  provider_type       = "gitlab"
  hypervisor_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  plan_id             = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"

  gitlab_url          = "https://gitlab.example.com"
  gitlab_token        = "glrt-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  gitlab_tag_list     = ["microvm"]
  gitlab_run_untagged = false
  warm_count          = 2
}

# GitHub pools CANNOT be created here: install the GitHub App from the
# panel's CI Runners page first, then adopt the linked pool with
#
#   terraform import iaas_microvm_runner_pool.github <pool-id>
#
# and manage it from then on (labels, max_concurrent, enabled, plan_id,
# hypervisor_group_id):
#
#   resource "iaas_microvm_runner_pool" "github" {
#     provider_type       = "github"
#     hypervisor_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
#     plan_id             = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
#     labels              = ["self-hosted", "linux", "x64"]
#     max_concurrent      = 4
#     enabled             = true
#   }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hypervisor_group_id` (String) UUID of the hypervisor group whose capacity runs this pool's CI jobs.
- `plan_id` (String) UUID of the MicroVM plan each runner job MicroVM is created from.
- `provider_type` (String) CI provider for the pool: "github" or "gitlab". Immutable - a pool cannot change provider, so changing this forces a new resource (GitHub pools are import-only and cannot be recreated here).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) (GitHub only) Whether the pool accepts new jobs from GitHub. Server-assigned at link time when omitted.
- `gitlab_run_untagged` (Boolean) (GitLab only) Whether the registered runners also pick up untagged jobs.
- `gitlab_tag_list` (List of String) (GitLab only) Tags assigned to the registered runners; jobs must request them to land on this pool.
- `gitlab_token` (String, Sensitive) (GitLab only) Runner authentication token. WRITE-ONLY: it is verified against GitLab on create and never returned by any API response afterwards, so it is preserved in state and cannot be recovered on import. Marked sensitive so it is never shown in plan/CLI output.
- `gitlab_url` (String) (GitLab only) Base URL of the GitLab instance the runners register with (e.g. https://gitlab.com).
- `labels` (List of String) (GitHub only) Runner labels advertised to GitHub Actions. The panel seeds the well-known self-hosted/linux/x64 labels at install time; keep the configuration in sync with them.
- `max_concurrent` (Number) Maximum number of runner jobs this pool executes concurrently. Server default applies when omitted.
- `warm_count` (Number) (GitLab only) Number of pre-registered warm runner MicroVMs kept ready. Server default applies when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the runner pool, assigned by the API.
